# A plan that cites a record

Background for the fixture: a plan is not a record, and nothing about it is
checked except the citations it makes into `docs/adr/`.

The plan restates the second decision, "A second decision, whose recorded
text" (`docs/adr/0002-cited.md:5`), which is the line whose recorded text the
baseline no longer matches.

The plan also cites a file that is not a record at all
(`lib/statifier_blocks/nothing.ex:12`), which is left to the compiler.
